$comment: Mention rules v4: semantic inputs, no signed events. Spec: README.md. Keys are lowercase 64-hex. Choice defaults: label = name, aliases = [name], agent/owned/managed = false. history maps key to recency (higher is more recent); presence maps key to online/away (missing is unknown). matching.expected is the tier (0 to 3) or null; ranking.expected is the full ordered key list; space.expected is a key or null. Expected outputs are literal, not generated by the code under test. A query may also be an exact public key (README Terms).
